project.description: AI model governance (plain Java, no Spring; package com.documentplatform.modelgov; docs/design/model-governance.md): the model register (models with their exact digest, uses with materiality, status and review dates, versioned with history and the app's audit), validation records (insert only; thresholds in force copied in), the change gate (Model approver with the separation rule, documented acceptance for medium-materiality customer models, go live and rollback per entity), the gate at model start (digest and configuration fingerprint), result stamping. Postgres store and SQL db/platform/modelgov (history table mg_schema_history, run only by the schema step), start-up check ModelGovSchema.verify; monitoring intake with drift and needs-review, re-validation due dates, and the documentation pack (JSON platform-model-pack/1 and PDF through Apache PDFBox).
